gaps.title: Missing GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows (build/test/lint gates)
gaps.description: The repo has no .github/workflows/* workflows to automate backend and frontend build/test/lint. This reduces confidence in changes and makes regressions more likely to land.
gaps.evidence: Repo tree at commit 52d33cc. No .github/workflows directory or yml files.
gaps.impact: Regressions can merge undetected; lower confidence in releases.

gaps.title: No Docker/Docker Compose for reproducible local run and deployment
gaps.description: There is no Dockerfile/docker-compose to run backend + frontend together in a standardized environment.
gaps.evidence: Repo tree at commit 52d33cc: no Dockerfile, no docker-compose.yml.
gaps.impact: Onboarding and deployment are less repeatable; env drift is more likely.

gaps.title: No application health endpoints (Actuator) for observability
gaps.description: Backend doesn't include Spring Boot Actuator, so there are no /actuator/health or metrics endpoints for runtime monitoring.
gaps.impact: Harder to monitor uptime, debug prod issues, and integrate with load balancers/health checks.

gaps.title: Missing CORS configuration for non-proxied frontend deployments
gaps.description: Backend doesn't explicitly configure CORS. Vite rolls through a proxy in dev, but production deployments often require CORS allowing frontend domains.
gaps.evidence: Backend source has no CORS config (e.g. WebMvcConfigurer) and no spring-security.
gaps.impact: Production frontend and API ondifferent domains may fail with browser CORS errors.

gaps.title: No authentication/authorization (all Todos are public)
gaps.description: API exposes full CRUD endpoints without user context. For a real task app, todos should be scoped to a user or account, or explicitly documented as single-user.
gaps.evidence: There is no spring-boot-starter-security in pom.xml, and controller exposes /api/todos.
gaps.impact: Data exposure risk if deployed publicly; cannot extend to multi-user scenarios easily.

gaps.title: Frontend has no unit/component tests
gaps.description: The frontend setup contains no test runner (e.g. Vitest/Jest) or test scripts.
gaps.evidence: frontend/package.json has no test script, and no test dependencies.
gaps.impact: Ui and data flow regressions are harder to catch; refactors less safe.

gaps.title: Backend test coverage is minimal (only basic controller tests)
gaps.description: While there are backend tests, the suite is small and does not explicitly cover repository/service layer and error scenarios comprehensively.
gaps.impact: Changes to data access and business logic can break undetected.

gaps.title: No API contract documentation (OpenAPI/ Swagger)
gaps.description: The API is documented in README but there is no machine-readable contract (OpenAPI spec) or Swagger UI.
gaps.evidence: There is no springdoc-openapi dependency in backend/pom.xml, and no /openapi.json files.
gaps.impact: Harder to integrate clients; docs can drift from reality.

gaps.title: No environment config strategy (profiles, env variables)
gaps.description: Backend uses a hard-coded SQLite database path (./data/todo.db) in application.yml without environment-specific profiles or override docs.
gaps.impact: Dev/test/prod configs are not clearly separated; deployment needs manual edits.

gaps.title: Obsolete handoff artifact present: gap-analysis-state.json
gaps.description: Repo contains docs/sdlc/handoff/gap-analysis-state.json, but the workflow requires docs/sdlc/handoff/gap-analysis-handoff.json as the only authoritative file. It also references an old commit and claims totalGaps = 20 while only 1 gap object exists.
gaps.evidence: docs/sdlc/handoff/gap-analysis-state.json exists at commit 52d33cc, its metadata.commit references 1961d8, and totalGaps mismatches gaps.length.
gaps.impact: Causes confusion for DLCR personas and possible wrong scope handoffs.
